verdict.rationale: Entra ID is managed programmatically through the Microsoft Graph API. The docs describe a single endpoint covering Microsoft cloud data and document user-object operations such as listing users, so a first-party management API clearly exists. Nothing in the pack establishes that the API matches everything the admin UI can do, and only user listing is shown at the operation level. The SCIM API is for provisioning into apps, not admin parity, so it is not credited. missing for 10: an explicit API-to-UI parity statement, documented API coverage of Conditional Access, lifecycle workflows, entitlement management, device and diagnostic settings, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Microsoft Graph API offers a single endpoint, https://graph.microsoft.com, to provide access to rich, people-centric data and insights in the Microsoft cloud, including Microsoft 365, Windows, and Enterprise Mobility + Security.
